name.en: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY, maternity benefit)

summary.en: Rs.5,000 for the first child (Rs.3,000 after antenatal check-up, Rs.2,000 after birth and 14 weeks of immunisation). Rs.6,000 for a second child if it is a girl, in one instalment

benefit.value_note: Rs.6,000 if this is a second girl child

en: Your nearest Anganwadi worker or ASHA worker can fill the online form for you.
You can also register yourself on the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in).
For a second girl child, registration during pregnancy is mandatory.

to_confirm: Other eligible groups include women with a BPL or National Food Security Act ration card, Ayushman Bharat (PMJAY) beneficiaries, e-Shram or MGNREGA job card holders, women farmers under PM-KISAN, and pregnant or lactating Anganwadi workers, Anganwadi helpers and ASHAs
Registration time limit is given as 270 days or nine months after childbirth in different sources; confirm at your Anganwadi
Required documents are not listed in the sources checked; ask your Anganwadi worker
Online portal address appears as pmmvy.wcd.gov.in in some sources and pmmvy.nic.in in others
